crossRefs.note: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in…
Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you…
When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…
A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to king Solomon; and Solomon…
The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house…
Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t go anywhere else.
translations.bsb: Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Build a house for yourself in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.
translations.kjv: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
translations.asv: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee a house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
